hero.title: What is your impact?
hero.subtitle: We all affect each other. But how?

intro_why.title: What is it about?
intro_why.text: Many of us fear being 'that difficult person'. But few bad feelings are born of malice. They are born of behavioral patterns that have gone too far.
bullets: Recognize when demands turn into exhaustion.
Understand why good intentions can turn into fear.
Find ways to make an impact without steamrolling others.

questions.1: I demand perfection from myself and others.
questions.2: I feel responsible for others' mistakes.
questions.3: I interrupt people if I know what they are going to say.
questions.4: I feel things only move forward if I do them myself.
questions.5: I secure my back before telling bad news.
questions.6: I feel emotions do not belong in the workplace.
questions.7: I keep information to myself so it is not misused.

A.title: Builder
A.subtitle: Sustainable Foundation
A.description: You create safety and clarity around you. People dare to come to you with unfinished business.
A.impact: You increase the team's psychological safety.
A.why: You are the one who holds it together.
A.next_step: Keep it up, but remember your own boundaries.

B.title: Pressure Cooker
B.subtitle: Hard and High
B.description: You demand a lot because you care. But sometimes your pace exhausts others.
B.impact: You may be creating an atmosphere of fear unintentionally.
B.motivation: You just want the best, but means can be too hard.

C.title: Gatekeeper
C.subtitle: Control is Safety
C.description: You protect your team or yourself by restricting information flow.
C.why: Openness is a risk, but closedness is destructive.
C.motivation: You fear chaos, so you manage information.
